description:
Search public meetings once across metadata and stored transcript text.

    Returns one card per meeting and native pagination metadata, without a total.
    Small current-text previews can be absent and do not establish timestamps.
    Text relevance can lag updates or match across untimed boundaries.
    Source transcripts searches stored text, including meetings without timed proof.

cursor.description: Native next_cursor or previous_cursor from the same query and filters.
cursor.title: Cursor

query.description: Analyzed words; put the whole query in double quotes for an analyzed phrase.
query.title: Query
